item.title: CJI Surya Kant bats for mediation as effective and win-win dispute resolution
item.description: Chief Justice of India Surya Kant on Friday said mediation is emerging as a successful, cost-effective and mutually beneficial way of resolving disputes, with growing acceptance across the judicial system.

item.title: Manmohan Singh’s legacy: quiet, principled leadership without spectacle
item.description: Renaming MGNREGA as ‘VB-G Ram G’ is more than semantics. It reflects an image-first politics that contrasts sharply with Manmohan Singh’s institution-led governance. Coming just before his first death anniversary, the symbolism is hard to miss.

item.title: Tension in Chomu after stone-pelting at police over mosque railing dispute
item.description: Chomu town in Rajasthan’s Jaipur district witnessed a tense early morning on Friday after a dispute over the installation of an iron railing outside a mosque escalated into clashes between local residents and police.

item.title: ECI to scrutinise West Bengal domicile certificates issued after July 2025
item.description: The Election Commission will closely scrutinise West Bengal domicile certificates issued after July 2025, used as ID documents for voters, ahead of hearings on the draft voters’ list starting Saturday.

item.title: Karnataka bus tragedy death toll rises to seven
item.description: The death toll in the sleeper coach bus fire in Chitradurga, Karnataka, rose to seven on Friday after the bus driver, who was critically injured in the crash, succumbed to his injuries.

item.title: Four arrested for pre-Christmas vandalism in Assam school
item.description: Four people linked to VHP and Bajrang Dal arrested for vandalising Christmas decorations at an Assam school and shops; Assam CM praises police for swift action, reaffirming commitment to peace and harmony

item.title: Delhi environment minister urges vigilance as pollution may rise again
item.description: Delhi Environment Minister Manjinder Singh Sirsa on Friday urged residents to remain cautious and adhere to pollution-control measures, warning that air quality could deteriorate again due to an approaching western disturbance.

item.title: Cold wave grips Jharkhand as temperatures plunge below 10°C
item.description: A cold wave has swept across Jharkhand, with minimum temperatures falling below 10 degrees Celsius in several districts, prompting the India Meteorological Department (IMD) to issue a ‘yellow’ alert for 12 regions until Saturday morning.

item.title: Kashmir cleric Mirwaiz Farooq removes Hurriyat chairman tag from X under pressure
item.description: Kashmir’s chief cleric, Mirwaiz Umar Farooq, announced on Friday that he had removed the Hurriyat chairman designation from his X (formerly Twitter) handle, describing the move as a “Hobson’s choice” following pressure from authorities.

item.title: NIA inspects Mysuru blast site after balloon vendor killed near palace
item.description: A team from the National Investigation Agency (NIA) on Friday inspected the site of a gas cylinder blast in Mysuru that claimed the life of a balloon vendor and left four others injured.
